craft_notes: CLOSING SEAL (mantra-fruit + Rudrayāmala named; abhyāsa last word). Sthāyin: got-joy. Close: staying. Rejected: 'Yamala literature' — killed: proper name kept; 'achieved' flat — 'got' kept.

lines: Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudra-Yāmala's way;
by its rehearsal, powers and all-knowing stay.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ mantraphalāvaptir ity etad rudrayāmalam | etad abhyāsataḥ siddhiḥ sarvajñatvam avāpyate

reads_against.argmap: Thus mantra-fruit getting: this Rudrayāmala; from practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness got.
c1_essence: Mantra-fruit got: Rudrayāmala; practice gives fruition.
